item.description:
### New
- A title's cast now shows real photos, not just initials. A TMDB key (in Settings, or baked in by whoever built this copy) gives an exact match; without one, a Wikipedia lookup fills in what it can. - A series' episodes now sit right on its detail page, with a season picker above them, instead of behind a separate list. - Pressing a tab you're already on now takes you back to that tab's top level, rather than sitting there doing nothing while a folder or detail page stays open on top of it. - A folder now has its own Movies / Shows / All filter, so a mixed catalog can be narrowed without leaving the folder.
### Bug fixes
- Streaming-service marketing tiles ("Netflix Top 10", "Apple TV+ Top 10", …) no longer show up as folders with nothing playable behind them. - A catalog whose genre comes back as the literal word "None" no longer shows "None" as if it were a real genre.
